contract: Run the incremental container probe and the combined container and Annex B probe over the supplied prefix with the declared read window. The formats build scores every compiled demuxer with av_probe_input_format3 on the same padded prefix and requires a score above AVPROBE_SCORE_RETRY.

Fold kind 3 followed by the verdict (0 unknown, 5 Matroska, 6 ISO BMFF, 8 MPEG-TS, 9 AVC, 10 HEVC), independent carrier width (0 unknown or ambiguous, 188 or 192), and replay presence. The reference carrier-width control checks three H.222.0 sync positions and the four-byte M2TS prefix.

For a selected container, fold the supplied prefix length and MD5 of the byte stream delivered by the returned source. The reference hashes the original input prefix. Raw selection exercises PlaybackProbe::finish and compares its returned codec. The raw source has no byte-level replay consumer in its public interface.
Load and truncate the input before the operation. The reference performs additional format scoring for every compiled demuxer.
